sampling.adaptation: 3 x 1M learning per replica, then frozen for 50M production
sampling.schedule: learn all four grids, then round-robin 250k frozen-grid production blocks
sampling.sample_definition: one joint channel/graph importance-sampling trial, including its complete angular/mirror packet; learning and auxiliary samples are separate
sampling.chart_probability_scope: Only the five threshold-soft graphs; all other graphs retain the D-style multichannel maps.

precision.preserve_term_collection_decimal_context: collect HP terms before leaving max(80,digits+24) Decimal context

resources.scope: one shared affinity mask for controller, integration workers, auxiliary workers and replay diagnostics

graph_scheme_convention: hard and raw graph contributions are reported; the auxiliary correction is channel-level and is not arbitrarily assigned to individual hard graphs
auxiliary_correlation: one common auxiliary estimate shared by all replicas; its error is counted once in the combined result
channel_error_convention: Channel and graph errors are marginal errors under joint sampling; total hard uncertainty is taken from pooled moments, not their quadrature sum.
timing_definition: CPU time is accumulated process CPU spent in evaluation, including precision retries and complete packets; production wall time is the sum of production-block wall times. No per-graph timings are assigned.
completion_evidence: All four replicas completed 50M production plus 3M learning; final auxiliary refinement completed

combination.formula: N=sum_r N_r; hard=PB*sum_r S_r/N; variance_hard=PB^2*(sum_r Q_r-(sum_r S_r)^2/N)/(N*(N-1)); matched=hard+shared_auxiliary; variance_matched=variance_hard+variance_auxiliary

numerical_validation.replay_scope: selected learning and production leaders, not an exhaustive check of all samples
